newsitem.title: CHINA: China sees growth of information technology firms.
newsitem.headline: China sees growth of information technology firms.

text.p: China's computer firms have shown rapid growth in recent years, upgrading their technology and quality to take on foreign competitors in the domestic market, the China Daily said on Saturday.

Of projected sales volume in China of two million personal computers this year, domestic firms will hold 30 percent, compared with 30 percent by foreign firms and 40 percent by domestic assembly plants with imported parts and components, it said.
Chinese computer companies have boosted their market share from just 20 percent in the early 1990s and less than 10 percent in the 1980s, it said quoting the Ministry of Electronics Industry.
